title: Endodontic pulp revitalization in traumatized necrotic immature permanent incisors: Early failures and long-term outcomes—A longitudinal cohort study
authors: Wikström A, Brundin M, Romani Vestman N, Rakhimova O, Tsilingaridis G. Int. Endod. J. 2022 Mar;00:1–16. doi: 10.1111/iej.13735. * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Our findings indicate that PR provides satisfactory clinical and radiographical outcomes in traumatized necrotic incisors. The failed cases were related to lack of bleeding and persistent infections, indicating that new techniques are needed to improve the predictability of PR” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
